title: HistoryOfPalestine Ali Tamimi
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدَ لِلّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَتُوْبُ اِلَيْه، وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا،

مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلاَ مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلاَ هَادِىَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ،

وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ صَل اللهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلى أله وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلّمَ وَبَعْد لا اله الا الله محمد الرسول الله وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُوْنِ۝

وَ لَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِیْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوْلًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَۚ وَعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا تُشْرِكُوْا بِهٖ شَیْــٴًـا وَ قَضٰى رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِیَّاهُ

As Allah سبحانه وتعالى says, وَ رَبُّكَ یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ وَ یَخْتَارُؕ-مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِیَرَةُؕ-سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ۝

اُولُوا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ أنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ وَلَا فَخْرَ سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِیْۤ اَسْرٰى بِعَبْدِهٖ لَیْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَا الَّذِیْ بٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهٗ

ارض المحشر والمنشر وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ لُوْطًا یٰقَوْمِ ادْخُلُوا الْاَرْضَ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ الَّتِیْ كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ فَاذْهَبْ اَنْتَ وَ رَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَاۤ

فَاِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَیْهِمْ اَرْبَعِیْنَ سَنَةًۚ یَتِیْهُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِؕ قُوْلُوْا حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ حِطَّةٌ حِنطَّةٌ حِنطَّةٌ

رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ وَهَبْ لِیْ مُلْكًا لَّا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِیْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ۝

اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِیْ بَطْنِیْ مُحَرَّرً نعم وَ التِّیْنِ وَ الزَّیْتُوْنِ ۝ وَ طُوْرِ سِیْنِیْنَ ۝ وَ هٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْاَمِیْنِ۝

وَطُوْرِ سِیْنِیْنَ۝

وَ هٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْاَمِیْن۝

فِیْ بُیُوْتٍ اَذِنَ اللّٰهُ اَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَ یُذْكَرَ فِیْهَا اسْمُهٗۙ فدولۃ الظلم ساعۃ ودولۃ عدل القیامۃ ساعۃ یا بلال قم فازن لا اله الا الله محمد الرسول الله

أقول قولي هذا واستغفر الله لي ولكم
english:
As we all have heard، the topic which will be discussed tonight, is a topic which is from the center of our beliefs.

It is a topic rooted in the Qur'an Allah's final revelation.

It is a topic that begins with the beginning of revelation to Allah's Prophet, Ibrahim عليه السلام and continues until the day of judgment with the return of the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام,

passing through the Qur'an and the Sunnah(سنۃ) and the Seerah(سیرۃ) of our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

It is a topic which cannot be separated from our testimony of faith.

There is none worthy of worship but Allah and Muhammad ﷺ is the Messenger of Allah.

It is a topic which is part of the cancer which the Muslims suffer from today.

And it is a topic which, unless we find a cure for it, we will not find a cure for other ills that we suffer from.

The topic is great indeed.

The topic deserves a whole conference, not just merely a lecture, and the topic deserves people of knowledge and honor to discuss it.

However we ask Allah عزوجل to assist us, in order that we may perhaps convey to our brothers and sisters some knowledge regarding this topic,

even though we ourselves are not from those, who deserve to discuss a topic of this importance.

In order to understand the situation in Palestine, one must begin with the matter of our faith, the essence of our belief, Tawheed(توحيد).

For as we all know Allah عزوجل has created us for a noble purpose.

Allah has created humanity and every single human being, indeed the jinns, for a great reason.

I have not created jinns nor human beings but to worship Me.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى has sent His Messengers as ones giving glad tidings and warning for this purpose, And We have sent to every single people a messenger, ordering that messenger to preach worship Allah alone and avoid the worship of a Tagoot(طاغوت),

all that is worshiped besides Allah.

And indeed Allah's revelation is centered upon this principle.

Throughout the Qur'an, we find the command to worship Allah and to avoid the worship of others.

And worship Allah alone and avoid the worship of others with Him.

And your Lord has decreed that you worship, only but Him; and so forth and so on.

And in the Sunnah(سنۃ) likewise, we find that our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ stressing this principle over and over.

One day his companion Muaaz bin Jabal رضي الله عنه is riding behind him on a donkey and the Prophet ﷺ says, O Muaaz(معاذ)! Do you know, when Allah's right is upon the creation?

Muaaz(معاذ) says Allah and His Messenger know best.

The Prophet ﷺ responds that His right meaning, Allah is right upon His creation is that His creation worship Him alone and does not associate anything with Him.

And then the Prophet ﷺ asked Muaaz(معاذ), and do you know what is the creations right upon Allah if they do that?

Muaaz(معاذ) replies Allah and His Messenger knows best.

The Prophet ﷺ says; Their right upon Allah that Allah will not punish them, if they do that.

This message of Tawheed(توحيد) for which We have been created, for which Allah سبحانه وتعالى has sent His messengers, for which Allah has sent down His scriptures,

and upon which Allah will judge every human being on the Day of Judgment, is the issue of Palestine.

It is an issue of Tawheed(توحيد) and Shirk(شرک).

It is an issue of Eeman(ایمان) and Kufr(کفر).

It is not an issue of nationalism or one race against another race, or one political philosophy against another political philosophy, but it is an issue of truth and falsehood.

It is an issue that begins with the father of the prophets, humanity's third father, the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام continuing to our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and concluding with the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام.

And in order to understand this issue, we must understand one aspect of Tawheed(توحيد); and that is that Allah سبحانه وتعالى, like He is the creator, He also is the One, Who selects.

Allahسبحانه وتعالى in Surat-Ul-Qasas(سورۃ القصص) says; And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses, they have no choice in the matter.

Glory be to Allah and exalted from that which they associate unto Him.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى, as He is the Creator, He is also the One, Who chooses and selects from His creation.

He has selected from His creation that the angels live in the heavens above, and from the angels, He has selected Jibrail(جبرائیل) and Mikail(میکائیل) and Israfil علیہم السلام.

He has selected from the creatures, on those who are upon earth human beings, and Has selected from the human beings, the prophets.

And selected from the prophets the messengers, and selected from the messengers, those five messengers of resolute determination.

the prophets Noah عليه السلام and Ibrahim عليه السلام and Musa عليه السلام and Eesa Ibn-E-Maryam عليه السلام and our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

And from those five messengers, He has chosen His two Khalil(خلیل)s, Ibrahim(ابراھیم) and Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہما وسلمہ.

And likewise from humanity, indeed, from everything He has chosen the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and selected him to be the master of all human beings, the leader of all humanity,

as the Prophet ﷺ has said; I am the master or the best of the children of Adam(آدم) and I say this not, out of a statement of boast.

Likewise Allah سبحانه وتعالى choses certain times.

In the week he has chosen the day of Al Jumua(جمعہ) as a day, when which we worship Him and remember His creation.

For Allah سبحانه وتعالى created the heavens and the earth in six days, the final day being the day of Jumuaa(جمعہ) And it is the day in which He has created Adam, and it is the day in which the Day of Judgment will occur.

So Allah has selected this day as the day of our weekly worship.

And likewise, He has chosen amongst the months, four months that are holy months, Muharram(محرم) and Rajab(رجب) and Zul Qada(ذوالقعدہ) and Zul Hijja(ذوالحجہ).

And He has also chosen amongst the months Ramadan(رمضان) as the month in which we fast and in the month which we worship Him, and in the month which He revealed the Qur'an.

And among nights, He chose Lelat-Ul-Qadar(لیلۃ القدر).

And likewise Allah سبحانه وتعالى has chosen places.

He has selected places in which He has honored and has set up for His worship alone.

He chose the lands of Mecca, and in Mecca, He chose a certain Valley in which His house was erected for His worship, the Ka’aba(کعبہ).

And He chose the lands of Medina.

And in Medina, He chose a certain part between its two valleys, in which the Prophet's Masjid was erected صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم.

And likewise, He chose the lands of Ash-Sham(الشام), the lands of Syria.

And from there, He chose specifically a certain city Bait-Al Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And from there He chose a certain hill, upon which Allah decreed that another Masjid(مسجد) be built, Masjid-Al-Aqsa(اقصی).

This is part of Tawheed(توحيد).

And this is why Allah سبحانه وتعالى made it part of our religion that one cannot set out in a journey for worship, except to these three Masajid(مساجد).

And the prayers in these Masajid(مساجد) are multiplied in terms of its reward, and there are certain etiquettes and certain rewards that are connected with these three Masajid(مساجد),

which are not connected with any other place on earth.

And so therefore, to separate Masjid-Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصی) from Mecca and Medina, it is as if to separate part of Islam from another part.

We are an Ummah(امۃ) of Tawheed(توحيد).

We are an Ummah(امۃ) which follows the prophets.

Do you not see that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, when he found the Jews fasting the day of Ashura (عاشورہ), he inquired what day is this?

They said, this is a noble day in which Allah سبحانه وتعالى rescued Moses from Pharaoh.

What did the Prophet ﷺ said; We are more deserving of Moses then them.

And likewise, Allah in the Qur'an has informed us, that the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام was neither a Jew nor a Christian, nor from the pagans, but he ever, he was a Muslim, a Hanif(حنیف),

and he was not from the pagans worshiping Allah alone.

And Allah tells us that the one, who is closest to Ibrahim عليه السلام were his immediate followers, and this prophet and the believers, meaning the Ummah of Muhammad ﷺ.

And do you not see, how Eesa عليه السلام, when he returns at the end of time, he returns as a Messenger, but judging by the Qur'an and the Sunnah, not with a new Sharia(شریعہ),

not ruling by the law, which was sent down to him, of the Injeel(انجیل) or of the Torah(توراۃ), but rather, as the Prophet ﷺ said؛ As a just ruler in this Ummah(امۃ).

So the Ummah(امۃ) of Muhammad ﷺ, we are the believers in all the revelation of Allah, and we are the believers in all the prophets of Allah.

And so therefore to separate parts of the places, which Allah has honored through some of his prophets، is as if we were to believe in part of the message and disbelieve in part of the message,

or believe in some of the messengers and disbelieve in the others of the messengers.

Baitul Maqdas, is connected to Mecca and Medina and can never be separated from it.

And the evidences upon this from the Quran and the Sunnah(سنۃ) are very many, and likewise from history.

And what we will do in the next few moments is review some of those evidences.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى in the Quran in five passages informs us that these lands of Ash-Sham(الشام), these lands of Syria and Lebanon and Palestine and Jordan, are lands in which Allah سبحانه وتعالى has blessed.

And in the passage which I think most of us are most familiar with, in where Allah سبحانه وتعالى opens up, starts Surat-Ul-Isra(سورۃ الاسراء), Allah سبحانه وتعالى says;

Glory be to Allah, Who took His servant meaning the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, during a night journey from Masjid-Al-Haram from Mecca to Masjid-Al-Aqsa(مسجدالاقصی),

regarding which we have blessed the surrounding lands.

and the connection; there is also a deep lesson in this.

Not only is Allah سبحانه وتعالى teaching us, or telling us an event of the Prophet ﷺ life, but as Shaykh Ul Islam Ibn Taymiyah(شَيْخُ الإِسْلَام اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّة) has said;

This also tells us the history of the Ummah(امۃ) in this, there is a deeper meaning.

For just like the message of Islam began in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, in Mecca, it will come at the end of time and be in Jerusalem.

And just like the beginning of the Ummah(امۃ), just like Mecca is more preferred and beloved to Allah عزوجل than Jerusalem, likewise the first of the Ummah(امۃ), meaning the Prophet ﷺ, his companions are better than those, who will be at the end of time, even though they will be with the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام.

And indeed in the Prophet Sunnah(سنۃ), we find many narrations in which the Prophet ﷺ has stressed the importance of Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

For example we find that the Prophet ﷺ has said in one Hadith(حدیث).

The Hadith(حدیث) of Memoona(میمونہ), the freed slave woman of the Prophet ﷺ.

This is reported by Imam Ahmed(امام احمد); She says; Oh Messenger of Allah, give us a Fatwa(فتوی); give us an answer regarding Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

So even though Sahabah(صحابہ) used to question the Prophet ﷺ regarding Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس)'s importance.

What did the Prophet ﷺ say, as reported by Imam Ahmad (امام احمد) in the Musnad(مسند) , he says; It is the land where the people will be gathered, and the land of the resurrection.

And then the Prophet ﷺ has said, come to it and pray there.

For a prayer, there is like a thousand prayers anywhere else, and the meaning is anywhere else, outside of Mecca, Masjid Haram(مسجد الحرام), and Masjid Nabawi(مسجد النبوی) in Madina,

and then Memoona(میمونہ) said, and if I cannot reach Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس), what should I do?

The Prophet ﷺ said, then give as an offering some oil by which you might light the Masjid(مسجد).

In other words, in the old days, before the advent of electricity, they would take oil and they would burn torches in order to give light in the Masajid(مساجد).

So here the Prophet ﷺ says to Memoona(میمونہ), if you cannot reach Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس), then send some oil there, in order to beautify that house of Allah عزوجل, so the people may pray there.

The people may recite the Qur'an there.

The people may do other acts of worship there.

And then the Prophet ﷺ said; whoever does such, it is like the person, who has gone there and prayed.

And in another Hadith (حدیث) of the Prophet ﷺ; The Prophet ﷺ was asked by Abu Zarr(ابوذر) what was the first Masjid(مسجد) built on earth.?

The Prophet ﷺ says, Masjid Al Haram(مسجدالحرام).

And the Hadith(حدیث) is in Bukhari(بخاری).

And then Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, Then which Masjid(مسجد)?

The Prophet ﷺ says, Masjid Al Aqsa(مسجدالاقصی) and there was fourty years between the two.

And likewise, the Prophet ﷺ teaches us another Hadith (حدیث) reported by Muslim(المسلم) upon his companion, Anas(انس).

The Prophet ﷺ says that the Buraaq(براق) which was the beast, which he rode for his Meraaj(معراج), was brought to him, and he rode it to Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And so then he tied the Buraaq(براق) to the ring in which the prophets would tie their animal, their horses and camels too.

And he entered into the Masjid(مسجد), and he prayed in their two Rakaats(رکعۃ), and then was raised to the heavens.

And indeed the Prophet ﷺ when he prayed in their two Rakaats(رکعۃ), he prayed with leading all the prophets of Allah, as the prophet ﷺ tells us in other Hadith (حدیث).

The Prophet ﷺ into another narration reported by Imam Ahmed(امام احمد); one of his companions by the name of  Zil Assabe(ذلاسابع), or Zul Assabe(ذولاسابع) asked the Prophet ﷺ says;

If we are tested, in other words, if we face a disaster, to live after you, then what do you order us? What do you command us?

In other words, the Prophet's companions knew that to live after the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, was a disaster, not to be in His presence.

What should we do if we're to live after you?

The Prophet ﷺ says, it is upon you to go to the house of worship, the Masjid Al Aqsa(مسجد الاقصی) in Jerusalem, and he says, For perhaps you might, will be given children who will then go there in morning and evening worshiping Allah there.

Indeed the Prophet ﷺ said; In another Hadith(حدیث), he asked Abu Zarr(ابوذر), he says to Abu Zarr(ابوذر) , he says, Oh Abu Zarr(ابوذر), what should you do if you are forced to leave Madina?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, If I am forced to leave Madina, I will only leave Madina and I will go to Mecca, and I will be like the pigeons of Mecca,

meaning I will stick as a pigeon of Mecca always there in Masjid Al Haram(مسجد الحرام), I will be there.

So the Prophet ﷺ says to Abu Zarr(ابوذر); And what will you do if you're forced to leave Mecca?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) said; I will then go to Ash-Sham(الشام) and to Bait-Ul-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And the Prophet ﷺ then asked Abu Zarr(ابوذر), what will you do if you're forced to leave Ash-Sham(الشام) and Bait-Ul-Maqdas(بیت المقدس)?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, I will then put my sword on my shoulder, meaning I will go and wage Jihad(جہاد) wherever it takes me in the world.

And another Hadith(حدیث) of the Prophet ﷺ, Abdullah Bin Amr Bin Al-Aas(عبداللہ بن عمرو بن العاص) tells us the Prophet ﷺ Says; There will be a Hijra(ھجرۃ) following a Hijra(ھجرۃ),

meaning that this Ummah(امۃ) will have Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijrah(ھجرۃ), leaving the lands of the unbelievers، until going to the lands of Islam, just like they left Mecca; the Prophet ﷺ his companions and went to Madina.

This is something which will continue, Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ), until the people finally make Hijra(ھجرۃ) to the place that Ibrahim make Hijra(ھجرۃ)

meaning the land of Palestine, meaning the city of Jerusalem and the local areas thereabouts.

In another Hadith(حدیث), the Prophet ﷺ puts his hand upon his companion, Ibn Hawal Al Azdi(ابن حوال الازدی), the Prophet ﷺ puts his hand on his head or on his forehead and says, Ibne Hawala (ابن حوالہ),

O son of Hawala(حوالہ), if you see the Khilafah(خلافہ) set up in Jerusalem, then know the days of earthquakes and tribulations and great matters have come, and Hour will be closer to you, than my hand is to your head.

And likewise, the Prophet ﷺ we know from his Seerah(سیرۃ) that while in he was Mecca, he used to face Bait-Ul- Maqdas(بیت المقدس) in prayer.

And then after he made Hijra(ھجرۃ) for 16 months, as Ibn Abbas (ابن عباس) tells us, he would face Bait-Ul- Maqdas(بیت المقدس) in prayer until the command came to him to face Mecca, the Ka'aba(کعبہ).

So the position of Palestine and these lands in the Qur'an and the Sunnah(سنۃ) cannot be denied.

And what I quoted of Hadith(حدیث) are just a few of the numerous Hadith(حدیث) regarding this land, which we will get into some other narrations as we go on in the lecture.

So the matter is not like as Daniel Pipes and other Zionists perceive.

When they say, you Muslims have Mecca; So why not give the Jews; Jerusalem?

Why not give Jerusalem to the Christians?

We can never do this, as we can never say we only believe in Muhammad ﷺ, and disbelief in Moses or Eesa علیہم السلام, the two maters are tied to our faith.

Now, what is the history of this place, Palestine in particular, Jerusalem, Bait-Ul-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

The history, as I mentioned, began with our father, the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام for as you know, the Prophet Ibrahimعليه السلام was born in the lands of Iraq, on the Euphrates River.

And he called the people to Towheed(توحيد) there, and he broke the idols there.

And then he was commanded by Allah to migrate, to leave those lands, as Allah سبحانه وتعالى said; We rescued him and Lut(لوط) to the lands which We blessed, meaning the lands of Palestine and Ash-Shaam(الشام).

And from there Ibrahim عليه السلام made another journey.

He went to Egypt, after he was in Palestine, due to a drought, but because of the oppressiveness of Pharaoh, as mentioned in the Hadith(حدیث),

he then had to leave that land, and he came back to Jerusalem.

And then finally, he went to Hijaz (حجاز), where he built, or rebuilt the Al-Kaaba(الکعبہ) with his son, Ismailعليه السلام.

But Ibrahim عليه السلام had another son.

Yes, he left Ismail(اسماعیل) and Hajar(ہاجر) in Mecca to establish, as Allah, mentions in the Qur'an, to leave from his descendants, who would then establish the prayer.

But he had another son, the prophet Yaqoob عليه السلام, and the Prophet Yaqoob(یعقوب) would worship Allah at the other place of worship, that Ibrahim عليه السلام established.

The Prophet Ishaq عليه السلام and the Prophet Yaqoob(یعقوب) worshiped Allah at the other house of worship, which the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام built

that is Masjid-Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصی) in Jerusalem.

And then we have the incident of the story of the Prophet Yousuf عليه السلام.

for the Prophet Yaqoobعليه السلام had 12 sons, and jealousy arose amongst the sons.

And we know the story, as Allah سبحانه وتعالى has described to us in the Qur'an and He said it's the most beautiful stories(احسن القصص), the most beautiful of stories.
